reviews.text: The MJ One Top Construction did an amazing job in my complete kitchen expansion/remodel and bathroom addition. I would definitely work with them again and recommend to anyone looking to complete construction projects for their home.

Marcin is the best!  He took our home renovation from vision to reality. His attention to detail, excellent communication, and talent gave us our dream home. He completed the project in the timeline promised. Would absolutely recommend!

Highly recommend Marcin’s work and would absolutely hire him for future projects.  He renovated our kitchen and we are extremely happy with it.  He is on time, takes pride in his work, positive and easy to work with.  Do not hesitate to work with Marcin.
